{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-43rp","title":"Migrate 48 host tests from manual main() to Criterion","description":"Migrate remaining host tests to Criterion test framework for reduced merge conflicts.

## Why
Host tests currently use manual main() with sequential test calls. This creates a merge conflict bottleneck when multiple agents add tests to the same file. Criterion auto-discovers Test() blocks at compile time - no shared registration.

## Reference implementation
link_ctx has been migrated as a working example:
- lichen/tests/link_ctx/main.c - Test() macros, no main()
- lichen/tests/link_ctx/CMakeLists.txt - pkg_check_modules(CRITERION)

## Scope
48 host test directories (non-Zephyr tests with manual main())

## Migration pattern per test
1. Replace `#include <stdio.h>` etc with `#include <criterion/criterion.h>`
2. Convert `static int test_foo(void) { ... return failed; }` to `Test(suite, foo) { ... cr_assert_*(...); }`
3. Delete main() entirely
4. Update CMakeLists.txt:
   - Add `find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)`
   - Add `pkg_check_modules(CRITERION REQUIRED criterion)`
   - Add ${CRITERION_INCLUDE_DIRS} to target_include_directories
   - Add ${CRITERION_LIBRARIES} to target_link_libraries
   - Add ${CRITERION_LIBRARY_DIRS} to target_link_directories

## Assertion mapping
| Before | After |
|--------|-------|
| `return condition != expected;` | `cr_assert_eq(condition, expected);` |
| `return memcmp(a, b, n) != 0;` | `cr_assert_arr_eq(a, b, n);` |
| `return ptr == NULL;` | `cr_assert_not_null(ptr);` |
| `if (x) return 1;` | `cr_assert(!x);` |

## Prerequisites
- Criterion installed: brew install criterion (done)
- link_ctx reference: verified working

## Parallelization

{"description":"Migrate remaining HOST tests to Criterion test framework for reduced merge conflicts.

## Scope clarification
- This is for HOST tests only (plain CMake, no Zephyr)
- Zephyr tests with manual main() have a separate epic: project-LICHEN-worker6-p4im

## Why
Host tests currently use manual main() with sequential test calls. This creates a merge conflict bottleneck when multiple agents add tests to the same file. Criterion auto-discovers Test() blocks at compile time - no shared registration.

## Reference implementation
link_ctx has been migrated as a working example:
- lichen/tests/link_ctx/main.c - Test() macros, no main()
- lichen/tests/link_ctx/CMakeLists.txt - pkg_check_modules(CRITERION)

## Migration pattern per test
1. Replace headers with `#include <criterion/criterion.h>`
2. Convert `static int test_foo(void) { ... return failed; }` to `Test(suite, foo) { ... cr_assert_*(...); }`
3. Delete main() entirely
4. Update CMakeLists.txt to link Criterion

## Prerequisites
- Criterion installed: brew install criterion (done)
